description_en: Deletes the configuration information of a specified domain name
description_zh: 删除指定域名配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi delete-domain --instance-id waf_elasticity-cn-0xldbqt0000 --domain www.example.com --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-09-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteDomain

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The domain name that has been added to WAF
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the WAF instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id
